name: jt-ipam Audit and Remote Access
summary: Logins and brute force, roles and permissions, API tokens, revealed secrets and full exports, console sessions (shadowing, typed-in privileged passwords, one account hopping across hosts), settings and backups of jt-ipam, from its journal, its audit trail, guacd and PostgreSQL; quiets jt-ipam's own nginx noise.
summary_zh: jt-ipam 的登入與暴力破解、角色與權限、API token、顯示機密與完整匯出、主控台工作階段（共用窺視、手動輸入的特權密碼、同一帳號連往多台主機）、設定與備份，取自服務記錄、稽核軌跡、guacd 與 PostgreSQL；並壓低 jt-ipam 自己的 nginx 雜訊。
notes: jt-ipam's service messages go to the systemd journal and reach Wazuh with no change on the host, through an agent that reads journald or /var/log/syslog. Wazuh's built-in FreeIPA decoder claims every program whose name contains "ipa", so before this pack every jt-ipam line ended at the FreeIPA rule 82202, level 0, with nothing decoded. Measured on one installation: about 180,000 jt-ipam lines a day, nearly all API requests and the integrations' HTTP calls; those stay at level 0.

From the journal: failed logins (web interface, second factor, phpIPAM-compatible API) are level 3 with the source address; 5 in 5 minutes from one address level 10 (each endpoint counted on its own); throttled login attempts level 6. The phpIPAM-compatible login is POST /api/phpipam/<app id>/user/: before 1.2 the pack looked for /api/<app id>/user/, so phpIPAM API logins were never counted and the brute-force rule and its active response could not fire. An accepted password is recorded at level 2, and is level 5 when the address is outside the private networks. A login accepted from that address within 10 minutes afterwards is level 12. A request refused for lack of permission (403) is recorded at level 2, and 10 from one address within a minute are level 8: someone walking the API for what the account may not use (measured: 4 single 403s in 30 days, from the web interface itself). Console connections that fail: target unreachable level 3, target rejected the credentials level 5, a RustDesk peer rejecting the password level 5 and repeated wrong RustDesk passwords level 7, SSH refused by the target level 5. A broken audit hash chain is level 12, failed anchoring level 7, a failed daily backup level 7 (measured: 28 failures in 30 days on one installation, which the built-in rule reported only as a generic service failure).

Integrations: the sync service logging in to another server over SSH as root is level 3, a write to the UCS directory through the UDM REST API level 5, and UDM refusing the integration's credentials level 5. Reading the directory (measured: about 1,500 requests a day) stays at level 0. These rules show what the integration accounts are used for; give them the least privilege that works, for example a read-only directory account when jt-ipam only reads DNS, and a dedicated non-root SSH account.

The audit trail is jt-ipam's own record of who did what. It is kept in its database and leaves it only as GELF messages (Audit forwarding in the administration area); the setup guide relays them into a file that the jt-ipam agent group reads. Then: logins with the account and the reason: a failure is level 5; a success is recorded at level 2 for an ordinary account from a private address, and alerts for an admin-class account (jt-ipam's built-in admin, administrator, root) at 3, from outside the private networks at 5 (admin-class 8), and for an account that was locked within the last 30 minutes at 12; account locked 10, a refresh token presented twice 10, second factor turned off or reset 7, recovery code used 5; accounts created 7 (administrator 10), deleted 7, administrator rights given 10, password reset by an administrator 7, account disabled 7; role membership, roles and permissions 7; API token created 10; a stored secret revealed 8; certificate export 8; stored console credentials 5. A full system export contains every stored secret of jt-ipam in plaintext inside one passphrase-sealed file: creating it is level 7, each download level 12 (level 10 before 1.2); a system import is level 10. Data exports (CSV, tables built in the browser, PDF reports) are level 3, and 5 from 1,000 rows. Deleting the AI assistant's chat history or the AI auditor's findings by hand is level 5, changing the chat retention level 3.

Console sessions from the audit trail: every SSH, RDP, VNC, noVNC, BMC, RustDesk and SFTP session that connected is recorded with the remote host, the account used on it, the jt-ipam user and the source address; opening the user's own RustDesk client on a peer counts as a RustDesk session. An ordinary session from a private address stays at level 2; a session as root, administrator or admin on the remote host is level 3 (measured: 70 of 137 sessions in 30 days, among them root SSH to a domain controller with a password jt-ipam stores), and level 5 when that privileged password was typed in for the session instead of taken from jt-ipam's stored credentials (measured: 7 in 90 days); a session opened from outside the private networks is level 5, and 8 as a privileged account. One jt-ipam account opening 8 sessions within 10 minutes, 7 of them to other targets than the last, is level 10 (measured: at most 6 such sessions by one account in any 10 minutes in 30 days). File transfers through the console 5; elevation requested in a remote desktop 5; settings 5; changes to audit forwarding 10; audit maintenance (chain repair) 10.

guacd, the console engine jt-ipam runs for RDP, VNC and SSH, has no authentication of its own and is bound to 127.0.0.1; jt-ipam opens a new guacd connection for every session and never joins a running one. guacd logging "Joining existing connection" is therefore a second party attaching to someone's live session (session shadowing): level 10; a join request for a connection that does not exist is level 7. These come from the journal (program guacd) and need no change on the host. guacd writes each message twice (to syslog and to standard error); only the syslog copy is matched, so each event alerts once. A manager that also receives the log of an Apache Guacamole server whose users share connections on purpose will see those shares too.

jt-ipam's own nginx traffic flooded Wazuh's built-in web server rules: measured on one installation over 10 days, 2,915 level 5 alerts for 5xx answers, 2,933 level 3 nginx errors and 1,093 level 5 alerts for 4xx answers, about 43 % of that host's alerts. The causes are routine: 502 while the backend restarts (103 restarts in 10 days, typically 30 to 45 seconds) and 401 on the web interface's background requests from browser tabs whose session expired. On jt-ipam's own API paths in an nginx log, a 502, 503 or 504 and the matching upstream error are now recorded at level 2, the expired-session 401s at level 0, and the backend being unreachable 40 times within 5 minutes (longer than a restart) is level 7, at most once per 30 minutes. Replaying those 10 days: 6,964 visible alerts become 217. Other applications, other paths, failed logins and 500 errors keep the built-in levels.

From 1.2 the jt-ipam agent group also reads PostgreSQL's log on the jt-ipam host, restricted on the agent to ERROR, FATAL and PANIC lines (measured: about 780 lines a day in all, 98 % of them routine LOG lines, which stay on the host together with the SQL statement lines). jt-ipam's audit table is append-only: its triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE, and from jt-ipam 1.0.6 the application's database role may only read and insert. Either refusal in the log is level 12: someone tried to alter or remove audit records (measured: 8 such lines in 30 days on one installation, from 4 manual checks of the protection). A failed database login is level 5, and 5 within 5 minutes level 10. This needs the Debian and Ubuntu default log line prefix and English server messages (setup guide).

Deliberately quiet: ordinary logins and sessions from private addresses, session ends, routine IP and device edits, scans, AI chats, the anchor heartbeat, deadlocks and other database errors, guacd's own connection messages, and certificate agents fetching a renewed bundle (level 2 from 1.2, measured 31 downloads by 12 agents in one renewal day; level 5 when the agent is outside the private networks). Nothing depends on a site's user names, hosts or lists: admin-class accounts are recognised by generic names only, jt-ipam's web paths are the product's own. A "first login of this account from this address" alert is not possible: Wazuh's first-time-seen (fts) never fired on these decoders, which must be children of the built-in FreeIPA decoder. Measured on one installation over 30 days, the change from 1.0 to 1.1 turned 222 level 3 alerts (logins and sessions) and 70 level 5 alerts (root sessions) into 70 level 3 alerts and recorded the rest at level 2.

Limits: an audit record names the acting account by its id, not its name. Turning audit forwarding off is recorded after the change takes effect, so that record is never forwarded: the stream simply stops. jt-ipam records a console session only once it has connected; a failed attempt is only in the journal. RustDesk clients' own alarms (wrong passwords, address not allowed) stay inside jt-ipam and are not in its audit trail. A database superuser who disables the audit table's triggers first leaves no line in PostgreSQL's log.
Active response is opt-in: blocking the source address of rules 131605, 131606 and 131609 on the jt-ipam host. See the risks below before enabling it.
notes_zh: jt-ipam 的服務訊息寫入 systemd journal，agent 只要有讀 journald 或 /var/log/syslog 就會送到 Wazuh，主機不必改設定。Wazuh 內建的 FreeIPA 解碼器會接走程式名稱中「任何位置」含 ipa 的程式，所以裝這個套件之前，jt-ipam 的每一行都停在 FreeIPA 規則 82202（level 0），什麼也沒解碼。實測一套安裝每天約 18 萬行，幾乎都是 API 請求與整合功能的 HTTP 呼叫，這些維持 level 0。

取自 journal：登入失敗（網頁介面、第二因素、phpIPAM 相容 API）為 level 3，帶來源位址；同一位址 5 分鐘內 5 次為 level 10（各端點分開計算）；登入被限流為 level 6。phpIPAM 相容 API 的登入路徑是 POST /api/phpipam/<app id>/user/：1.2 以前套件找的是 /api/<app id>/user/，所以 phpIPAM API 的登入從未被計算，暴力破解規則與它的主動回應都不可能觸發。密碼通過只記錄為 level 2，來源位址不在私有網段時為 level 5。之後 10 分鐘內同一位址登入成功為 level 12。因權限不足被拒絕的請求（403）只記錄為 level 2，同一位址一分鐘內 10 次為 level 8：有人在 API 裡試探這個帳號不能用的東西（實測 30 天只有 4 次單獨的 403，來自網頁介面本身）。主控台連線失敗：目標連不到 level 3、目標拒絕帳密 level 5、RustDesk 對端拒絕密碼 level 5、一再輸錯 RustDesk 密碼 level 7、目標拒絕 SSH 登入 level 5。稽核雜湊鏈斷裂為 level 12，錨定失敗 level 7，每日備份失敗 level 7（實測一套安裝 30 天內失敗 28 次，內建規則只把它當成一般的服務失敗）。

整合功能：sync 服務以 root 透過 SSH 登入其他伺服器為 level 3，經 UDM REST API 寫入 UCS 目錄為 level 5，UDM 拒絕整合帳號的帳密為 level 5。讀取目錄（實測每天約 1,500 次請求）維持 level 0。這些規則讓人看得到整合帳號實際被拿來做什麼；請給它們夠用的最小權限，例如 jt-ipam 只讀 DNS 時用唯讀的目錄帳號，SSH 用專用的非 root 帳號。

稽核軌跡是 jt-ipam 自己記下的「誰做了什麼」。它存在資料庫裡，只會以 GELF 訊息送出（管理區的「稽核轉送」）；設定指南用一個轉送程式把它寫成檔案，由 jt-ipam agent 群組讀取。之後可看到：登入帶帳號與原因：失敗為 level 5；成功時，一般帳號從私有位址登入只記錄為 level 2，admin 類帳號（jt-ipam 內建的 admin、administrator、root）為 3，來源不在私有網段為 5（admin 類 8），30 分鐘內曾被鎖定的帳號登入為 12；帳號被鎖定 10、refresh token 被重複出示 10、第二因素被關閉或重設 7、使用復原碼登入 5；建立帳號 7（管理者 10）、刪除帳號 7、授予管理權限 10、管理者重設密碼 7、停用帳號 7；角色成員、角色與權限變更 7；建立 API token 10；顯示儲存的機密 8；匯出憑證 8；主控台儲存帳密的變更 5。完整系統匯出把 jt-ipam 儲存的所有機密以明文放進一個用密語封裝的檔案：建立匯出為 level 7，每次下載為 level 12（1.2 以前為 10）；套用系統匯入為 level 10。資料匯出（CSV、瀏覽器產生的表格、PDF 報表）為 level 3，1,000 列以上為 5。手動刪除 AI 助理的對話記錄或 AI 稽核的發現為 level 5，變更對話保留期限為 level 3。

主控台工作階段取自稽核軌跡：每個連上的 SSH、RDP、VNC、noVNC、BMC、RustDesk、SFTP 工作階段都會記下遠端主機、在遠端使用的帳號、jt-ipam 使用者與來源位址；透過 jt-ipam 用使用者自己的 RustDesk 用戶端開啟對端，也算 RustDesk 工作階段。從私有位址開啟的一般工作階段維持 level 2；在遠端以 root、administrator 或 admin 登入為 level 3（實測 30 天 137 個工作階段中有 70 個，包括以 jt-ipam 儲存的密碼用 root SSH 登入網域控制站），若這個特權密碼是當次手動輸入、而非取自 jt-ipam 儲存的帳密，為 level 5（實測 90 天 7 次）；從私有網段以外開啟為 level 5，以特權帳號則為 8。同一個 jt-ipam 帳號 10 分鐘內開了 8 個工作階段、其中 7 個連往與最後一個不同的目標，為 level 10（實測 30 天內單一帳號任何 10 分鐘最多 6 個這樣的工作階段）。經主控台傳輸檔案 5；在遠端桌面要求提權 5；設定變更 5；稽核轉送設定變更 10；稽核維護（修復雜湊鏈）10。

guacd 是 jt-ipam 用來跑 RDP、VNC、SSH 的主控台引擎，本身沒有任何驗證，只綁 127.0.0.1；jt-ipam 每個工作階段都開新的 guacd 連線，從不加入正在進行的連線。所以 guacd 記下「Joining existing connection」就表示有第二方接上別人正在使用的工作階段（共用窺視）：level 10；要求加入一個不存在的連線為 level 7。這些取自 journal（程式名稱 guacd），主機不必改設定。guacd 每則訊息會寫兩次（syslog 與標準錯誤輸出），規則只比對 syslog 那份，所以每件事只告警一次。若同一台 manager 也收到 Apache Guacamole 伺服器的記錄，而該處的使用者會刻意共用連線，這些共用也會出現。

jt-ipam 自己的 nginx 流量會淹沒 Wazuh 內建的網頁伺服器規則：一套安裝 10 天實測，5xx 回應的 level 5 告警 2,915 筆、nginx 錯誤 level 3 共 2,933 筆、4xx 回應 level 5 共 1,093 筆，約佔該主機告警的 43%。原因都是例行的：後端重啟時的 502（10 天重啟 103 次，通常 30 到 45 秒），以及工作階段已過期的瀏覽器分頁在背景發出的請求得到 401。現在在 nginx 記錄中、jt-ipam 自己的 API 路徑上，502、503、504 與對應的 upstream 錯誤只記錄為 level 2，過期工作階段的 401 為 level 0；5 分鐘內 40 次連不到後端（比一次重啟久）為 level 7，最多每 30 分鐘一次。以這 10 天重新計算：6,964 筆可見告警變成 217 筆。其他應用程式、其他路徑、登入失敗與 500 錯誤維持內建等級。

1.2 起 jt-ipam agent 群組也讀取 jt-ipam 主機上 PostgreSQL 的記錄，並在 agent 端只送出 ERROR、FATAL、PANIC 這幾種行（實測每天共約 780 行，98% 是例行的 LOG 行，這些與 SQL 敘述行都留在主機上）。jt-ipam 的稽核資料表只能新增：觸發器會拒絕 UPDATE、DELETE、TRUNCATE，而從 jt-ipam 1.0.6 起應用程式的資料庫角色只能讀取與新增。記錄中出現任一種拒絕都是 level 12：有人試圖修改或刪除稽核記錄（實測一套安裝 30 天內 8 行，來自 4 次手動測試這項保護）。資料庫登入密碼錯誤為 level 5，5 分鐘內 5 次為 level 10。這需要 Debian／Ubuntu 預設的記錄行前綴與英文的伺服器訊息（見設定指南）。

刻意保持安靜：從私有位址的一般登入與工作階段、工作階段結束、例行的 IP 與裝置編輯、掃描、AI 對話、錨定心跳、死結等其他資料庫錯誤、guacd 自己的連線訊息，以及憑證 agent 取回續期後的憑證包（1.2 起為 level 2，實測一次續期當天 12 個 agent 下載 31 次；agent 不在私有網段時為 level 5）。不依賴站台的使用者名稱、主機或清單：admin 類帳號只以通用名稱辨識，網頁路徑是產品本身的路徑。無法提供「這個帳號第一次從這個位址登入」的告警：這些解碼器必須是內建 FreeIPA 解碼器的子解碼器，而 Wazuh 的首次出現（fts）在它們身上從未觸發。以一套安裝 30 天的實測資料，1.0 到 1.1 的變化是：原本 222 筆 level 3（登入與工作階段）與 70 筆 level 5（root 工作階段），變成 70 筆 level 3，其餘只記錄為 level 2。

限制：稽核記錄只以 id 記下執行操作的帳號，沒有名稱。關閉稽核轉送的那筆記錄是在設定生效後才寫入，所以永遠不會被轉送出去：資料流只是停了。jt-ipam 只在主控台工作階段連上之後才記錄；連線失敗只出現在 journal。RustDesk 用戶端自己的警報（密碼錯誤、位址不允許）只留在 jt-ipam 內，不在稽核軌跡裡。資料庫超級使用者若先停用稽核資料表的觸發器，PostgreSQL 記錄中不會留下任何一行。
主動回應需自行啟用：在 jt-ipam 主機上封鎖觸發規則 131605、131606、131609 的來源位址。啟用前請先看下方的風險說明。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: jt-ipam
agent_group.description: The jt-ipam audit trail, which a local rsyslog relay writes to /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log, and PostgreSQL's log (ERROR, FATAL and PANIC lines only)

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Check that the agent on the jt-ipam host reads the journal
setup.title_zh: 確認 jt-ipam 主機上的 agent 有讀 journal
setup.body: jt-ipam writes its service messages to the systemd journal (jt-ipam-backend, jt-ipam-sync, jt-ipam-backup). Agents installed on Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 12 read journald by default; older installations read /var/log/syslog, where rsyslog copies the same lines. If the agent's ossec.conf has either, nothing changes. If it has neither, add the journald block below to that agent's own ossec.conf and restart the agent. Do not add it where /var/log/syslog is already read, or every line arrives twice.
setup.body_zh: jt-ipam 把服務訊息寫入 systemd journal（jt-ipam-backend、jt-ipam-sync、jt-ipam-backup）。Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 12 上安裝的 agent 預設就讀 journald；較舊的安裝讀 /var/log/syslog，rsyslog 會把同樣的內容複製過去。agent 的 ossec.conf 有其中之一就不必改。兩者都沒有時，把下面的 journald 區塊加進該 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 並重啟 agent。已經在讀 /var/log/syslog 的主機不要再加，否則每一行都會收到兩次。
setup.verify: Fail a login to jt-ipam on purpose. Expect rule 131602 (level 3) with your address on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 故意在 jt-ipam 登入失敗一次，manager 端應出現規則 131602（level 3），帶你的位址。

setup.title: Relay the audit trail into a file
setup.title_zh: 把稽核軌跡轉寫成檔案
setup.body: jt-ipam sends its audit trail to one destination only, as GELF over UDP or TCP. Point it at a local rsyslog listener that writes each message as a syslog line (program jt-ipam-audit) to /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log and, if a collector such as Graylog received the trail before, passes every message on to it unchanged (the commented omfwd line). Run the commands below as root on the jt-ipam host: rsyslog restarts once, for a few seconds, while the journal keeps buffering; jt-ipam does not restart. Then in jt-ipam, Administration, Audit forwarding: host 127.0.0.1, port 5515, protocol UDP, format GELF. The syslog and CEF formats are not used here because they leave out the record's details (account name, reason, remote host). Without this step the pack still works from the journal, without account names, roles, permissions, tokens, secrets or sessions.
setup.body_zh: jt-ipam 只能把稽核軌跡送到一個目的地，格式為 GELF（UDP 或 TCP）。請把它指向本機的 rsyslog 監聽埠，由 rsyslog 把每則訊息以 syslog 格式（程式名稱 jt-ipam-audit）寫進 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log；若原本有 Graylog 之類的收集端在收，也原封不動轉給它（取消 omfwd 那行的註解）。以 root 在 jt-ipam 主機上執行下列指令：rsyslog 會重啟一次，約數秒，期間 journal 會繼續暫存；jt-ipam 不會重啟。接著在 jt-ipam 的「管理 → 稽核轉送」設定：主機 127.0.0.1、埠 5515、協定 UDP、格式 GELF。不用 syslog 與 CEF 格式，因為它們不含記錄的細節（帳號名稱、原因、遠端主機）。不做這一步，套件仍可從 journal 運作，但沒有帳號名稱、角色、權限、token、機密與工作階段。
setup.code:
cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/30-jt-ipam-audit.conf <<'EOF'
# jt-ipam audit trail: GELF over UDP from 127.0.0.1, written as syslog lines
module(load="imudp")    # delete this line if imudp is already loaded
template(name="jtipam_line" type="string"
         string="%timegenerated% %$myhostname% jt-ipam-audit: %rawmsg%\n")
template(name="jtipam_gelf" type="string" string="%rawmsg%")
ruleset(name="jtipam_audit") {
  action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log" template="jtipam_line" fileCreateMode="0640")
  # Keep feeding a GELF collector that received the trail before (optional):
  # action(type="omfwd" target="<collector>" port="<gelf udp port>" protocol="udp" template="jtipam_gelf")
  stop
}
input(type="imudp" address="127.0.0.1" port="5515" ruleset="jtipam_audit")
EOF
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/jt-ipam-audit <<'EOF'
/var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log {
  daily
  rotate 14
  compress
  delaycompress
  missingok
  notifempty
  postrotate
    systemctl kill -s HUP rsyslog.service
  endscript
}
EOF
rsyslogd -N1 && systemctl restart rsyslog
setup.verify: Use Test on the Audit forwarding card, then run tail -1 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log: a line ending in a JSON object that starts with {"version": "1.1".
setup.verify_zh: 在「稽核轉送」卡片按「測試」，再執行 tail -1 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log：應看到一行，結尾是以 {"version": "1.1" 開頭的 JSON。

setup.title: Assign the jt-ipam host to the jt-ipam group
setup.title_zh: 把 jt-ipam 主機加入 jt-ipam 群組
setup.body: The group makes the agent read /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log and, from 1.2, PostgreSQL's log (next step). Do this after the relay above exists, then restart the agent so it opens the files.
setup.body_zh: 群組會讓 agent 讀取 /var/log/jt-ipam-audit.log，1.2 起也讀 PostgreSQL 的記錄（見下一步）。請在上一步的轉寫設定好之後再做，並重啟 agent，讓它開啟這些檔案。
setup.verify: Log in to jt-ipam as admin (or fail a login on purpose). Expect rule 131678 (level 3), or 131633 (level 5), with the account name. An ordinary login from a private address is recorded at level 2 and does not alert.
setup.verify_zh: 以 admin 登入 jt-ipam（或故意登入失敗一次），manager 端應出現規則 131678（level 3）或 131633（level 5），帶帳號名稱。一般帳號從私有位址登入只記錄為 level 2，不會告警。

setup.title: Check PostgreSQL's log format for the audit-table rules
setup.title_zh: 確認 PostgreSQL 的記錄格式，讓稽核資料表規則可用
setup.body: From 1.2 the jt-ipam group also reads /var/log/postgresql/postgresql-*-main.log on the jt-ipam host and sends only its ERROR, FATAL and PANIC lines; the routine LOG lines and the SQL statement lines stay on the host. This is how a refused change to jt-ipam's append-only audit table becomes a level 12 alert. The rules expect the Debian and Ubuntu default log_line_prefix ('%m [%p] %q%u@%d ', the default since PostgreSQL 10 on these systems) and English messages (lc_messages C or en_US.UTF-8). Check both with the first command; when they match, nothing changes on the host. Agents already in the group open the new file after a restart of the agent (second command). If jt-ipam's database runs on another server, put that server's agent in the group instead.
setup.body_zh: 1.2 起 jt-ipam 群組也會讀取 jt-ipam 主機上的 /var/log/postgresql/postgresql-*-main.log，只送出 ERROR、FATAL、PANIC 這幾種行；例行的 LOG 行與 SQL 敘述行都留在主機上。稽核資料表只能新增，資料庫一旦拒絕對它的修改，就會因此成為 level 12 告警。規則預期 Debian／Ubuntu 預設的 log_line_prefix（'%m [%p] %q%u@%d '，這些系統自 PostgreSQL 10 起的預設值）與英文訊息（lc_messages 為 C 或 en_US.UTF-8）。用第一個指令確認兩者；相符的話主機不必改任何設定。已在群組中的 agent 重啟後（第二個指令）才會開啟這個新檔案。若 jt-ipam 的資料庫在另一台伺服器上，請改把那台伺服器的 agent 加入群組。
setup.code:
sudo -u postgres psql -Atc 'SHOW log_line_prefix' -c 'SHOW lc_messages'
systemctl restart wazuh-agent
setup.verify: As postgres on the jt-ipam host (jt-ipam 1.0.6 or later): psql -d jt_ipam -c 'SET ROLE jt_ipam' -c 'UPDATE audit_logs SET action = action WHERE false'. It changes nothing and fails with "permission denied for table audit_logs"; expect rule 131687 (level 12) on the manager. The alert is real by design: tell whoever watches the alerts first.
setup.verify_zh: 在 jt-ipam 主機上以 postgres 身分執行（jt-ipam 1.0.6 以上）：psql -d jt_ipam -c 'SET ROLE jt_ipam' -c 'UPDATE audit_logs SET action = action WHERE false'。它不會改到任何資料，會以「permission denied for table audit_logs」失敗；manager 端應出現規則 131687（level 12）。這是刻意產生的真告警，請先告知看告警的人。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to jt-ipam
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 jt-ipam 失敗的位址
active_response.body: After 5 failed logins from one address in 5 minutes (rule 131606 for the web interface, 131609 for second-factor codes, 131605 for the phpIPAM-compatible API), drops all traffic from that address on the jt-ipam host for 10 minutes, with iptables or nftables. The address is the one nginx on the host saw. If jt-ipam sits behind another reverse proxy or load balancer that does not pass the client address on, that proxy is the address and the block shuts everyone out: do not enable it there. Risks: an administrator who mistypes a password repeatedly loses the web interface and SSH to the host for 10 minutes, and so does everyone behind the same NAT address (jt-ipam itself already locks the account for 15 minutes after 5 failures). Put the management networks and the host's own addresses in the manager's white_list first; local scripts that log in through 127.0.0.1 must never be blocked (127.0.0.1 is in the default white_list). When jt-ipam is reachable from outside, blocking at the perimeter firewall is better, for example the OPNsense agent's opnsense-fw command.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址 5 分鐘內登入失敗 5 次（網頁介面為規則 131606、第二因素驗證碼為 131609、phpIPAM 相容 API 為 131605）後，在 jt-ipam 主機上以 iptables 或 nftables 封鎖該位址的所有流量 10 分鐘。位址取自主機上 nginx 看到的來源。若 jt-ipam 前面還有另一層不轉交用戶端位址的反向代理或負載平衡器，位址就會是那台代理，封鎖等於擋掉所有人：這種架構請勿啟用。風險：一再打錯密碼的管理者會有 10 分鐘連不上這台主機的網頁介面與 SSH，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有使用者也一樣（jt-ipam 本身已會在失敗 5 次後鎖定帳號 15 分鐘）。請先把管理網段與主機自己的位址加入 manager 的 white_list；經 127.0.0.1 登入的本機腳本絕不能被封鎖（127.0.0.1 在預設的 white_list 中）。若 jt-ipam 可從外部連線，在邊界防火牆封鎖更好，例如 OPNsense agent 的 opnsense-fw 指令。
